method: targeted source-English semantic review in adjacent verse context; printed edition source IDs; inventory-142 manuscript alignment remains provisional

corrections.reason: Капыр is an infidel epithet; this line and the next name the addressee of the quoted speech.
Алп and баатыр are heroic epithets for Sarybai, not a second unnamed hero.

corrections.en: Put your full strength into it,
corrections.reason: Мыктылап күчкө салыңыз urges the fighter to use his strength.

corrections.old: Don't rush out of your mind,
corrections.en: Don't lose your wits and rush,
corrections.reason: Акылдан тайып шашпаңыз warns against losing judgment and rushing.
Аң-таң уруп adds bewilderment to the warning not to flee.

corrections.en: Her words seemed sweet as sherbet,
corrections.reason: Кеби шербет is a metaphor for pleasing speech, not an untranslated person or object.

corrections.en: Standing tall as a white stag,
corrections.reason: Ак бугу is a white stag; даңкайып depicts its imposing stature.
Ала аскар is a high mountain or crag, not a soldier.
Балбан кыял шер жүрөк praises strength of spirit and a lion heart, not a wrestler’s dream.

corrections.en: She strode out and stood there.
corrections.reason: Бастырып чыгып турду эле describes Kuyaly moving forward and standing, not printing.

corrections.en: He rumbled and stirred himself up,
corrections.reason: Күңгүрөнүп күүлөндү describes a deep vocal sound and gathering fervor.

corrections.en: Snorting, he took on many forms,
corrections.reason: Күрсүлдөп is a forceful sound; нечен түрлөндү means changing in many ways.
Жарактарын means his weapons or gear; it is not wounds.
Жалаңдаган describes vigorous, threatening movement; кутургур is the enraged figure.
Алышар жагын камданды means preparing for the combat ahead, not naming Alyshar.
Каарданып камынды conveys both anger and preparation.
Кара болот байланып describes battle gear strapped on in the continuing preparation.

corrections.en: His anger showed on his face,
corrections.reason: Каары бетине айланып places his anger visibly in his expression.
Сакал-мурут бириндеп describes hairs separating or standing apart in anger.

corrections.old: Make the moon and the universe,
corrections.en: As though commanding the whole world,
corrections.reason: Ай-аалам means the world at large; буй кылып is commanding it.
Аны көрүп турган жан refers to any onlooker seeing the warrior.
Азат бою is the whole body; дүркүрөп here describes a fearful shudder.
Найза кармап чыңданып has both gripping the spear and bracing for combat.

corrections.old: He gathered his strength and listened.
corrections.en: Gathering his strength, he braced himself,
corrections.reason: Тыңданып means strengthening or bracing oneself here, not listening.

corrections.old: The power is like a flood,
corrections.en: His strength seemed like a flood,
corrections.reason: Күчү селдей көрүнүп likens his strength to a flood.
Күркүрөдү is a verb of roaring or thundering; кутургур names the raging figure.

corrections.en: Turning sideways like a white doe,
corrections.reason: Кыйгачтап describes an angled or sideways motion; it does not describe the deer as malformed.

corrections.old: When I saw it, I was shocked.
corrections.en: At the sight, every eye was drawn,
corrections.reason: Көргөндө көңүл бөлүнүп describes attention turning upon seeing her; the source has no first-person shock.
